key_provisions_or_claims: Croatia authorised to exempt from tax gas oil used in humanitarian demining machinery.
Exemption limited to accredited special-purpose machines built for clearing mined areas.
Ceases earlier if Council adopts general demining tax rules.
Without prejudice to EU State aid rules.
annotation.summary_en: Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/786 authorises Croatia to apply a tax exemption on gas oil used in accredited special-purpose humanitarian demining machinery from December 2020 to December 2026, under Directive 2003/96/EC. Not about AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/786 of 10 May 2021 authorising the Republic of Croatia to apply a tax exemption to gas oil used to operate machinery in humanitarian demining in accordance with Article 19 of Directive 2003/96/EC
